correctness.rationale: CG residual p_k is the normalized degree-k orthogonal polynomial for the positive b_i^2 spectral measure. Ritz zeros in [mu,L] give |1-lambda/theta|<=1 when L<=2mu and hence |p_k(lambda)|<=1; x_{k,i}=b_i/lambda_i*(1-p_k(lambda_i))>=0. At convergence residual zero. Two-mode systems converge within two steps. For kappa>2, diag(1,kappa/2,kappa), b=(1,1,eps) has p2(kappa)->kappa-1>1 and negative third coordinate for small eps. Identical exact-line-search Broyden iterates follow a cited existing CG equivalence. Independent rational recurrence reproduced the kappa=4 negative second iterate.

value.rationale: Coordinatewise positivity is a natural feasibility invariant for iterative solvers with nonnegative solutions, not controlled by standard CG energy-norm convergence. A dimension-free all-step safe region plus the minimal dimension and iteration of failure gives a sharp structural boundary usable when selecting unsafeguarded CG/BFGS on nonnegative diagonal problems.

scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; positive diagonal in tested coordinate basis, zero start and b>=0; does not extend unchanged to general SPD basis or finite precision.
